critical.description: Database modules must not depend on datasource modules
critical.message: Database module cannot depend on datasource module - creates circular dependency

critical.description: Room entities must be in database module, not datasource
critical.message: Room entities must be in database module for proper separation of concerns

critical.description: ViewModels must not directly inject repositories
critical.message: ViewModels should only inject use cases, not repositories directly

critical.description: NavigationHost must be properly implemented, not empty or commented
critical.message: NavigationHost must include proper startDestination and navigation setup

critical.description: App module must include view module dependencies
critical.message: App module must include view module dependencies for UI accessibility

critical.description: API keys and secrets must not be hardcoded in templates
critical.message: Use BuildConfig or secure storage for secrets, never hardcode them

high.message: All ViewModels must be annotated with @HiltViewModel for proper DI
Use manual instantiation in DI modules instead of @Inject constructors

high.description: Repository implementations must be separate from interfaces
high.message: Repository interfaces and implementations must be in separate files/modules

high.description: HTTP logging SECURITY CRITICAL - must be debug-only configuration
high.message: SECURITY CRITICAL: HTTP body logging exposes sensitive data in production logs

high.description: Destructive migration should not be used in production
high.message: DATA CRITICAL: Destructive migration causes data loss in production updates

high.description: Database configuration must be build-aware (debug vs production)
high.message: PRODUCTION CRITICAL: Database must have different configurations for debug vs production builds

high.description: Room entities must not be in DataSource layer - architectural violation
high.message: ARCHITECTURAL VIOLATION: Room entities must be in database module, not datasource layer

high.description: DataSource layer must not import Domain models directly
high.message: DEPENDENCY INVERSION VIOLATION: DataSource layer cannot import Domain - map at Infrastructure layer

high.description: Catch blocks must not return empty results without logging
high.message: SILENT FAILURE: Errors must be logged and propagated, not hidden with empty results

high.description: Complex data should not be stored as JSON strings in database
high.message: PERFORMANCE ISSUE: Use Room relationships or TypeConverters instead of JSON strings

high.description: DataSource module must depend on Database module
high.message: DataSource module must depend on Database module for proper layer separation

high.description: TypeConverter classes must contain actual converter methods
high.message: ARCHITECTURAL ISSUE: Empty TypeConverter classes provide no value - implement actual converters or remove

high.description: JSON fields must have consistent handling approach
high.message: CONSISTENCY ISSUE: Use either TypeConverters OR proper object types consistently across all JSON fields

medium.description: ViewModels should use single StateFlow pattern
medium.message: Use single StateFlow for UI state management

medium.description: Use cases should not be marked as Singleton unless necessary
medium.message: Use cases are typically per-injection scoped

medium.description: Avoid mixing example packages with actual project packages
medium.message: Replace com.example.starterdemo with actual project package name consistently

medium.description: Use cases should follow single responsibility principle
medium.message: Use cases should have single responsibility (operator invoke only), create separate use cases for different operations

medium.description: Avoid N+1 query patterns with sequential API calls
medium.message: Use batch API calls instead of sequential calls to prevent performance issues
